title: Deep learning distinguishes COVID-19 from other pneumonia on chest CT
summary: U-Net lung extraction and a ResNet-50-based network (IDANNet) were trained on 563 CT scans from 380 patients at 5 hospitals, with AUC 0.906 in internal validation. On 318 scans from 316 patients prospectively enrolled at 2 other hospitals, AUC was 0.868 with sensitivity 0.811 and specificity 0.822, non-inferior to three experienced radiologists.
ai_technology: U-Net lung segmentation with a ResNet-50-based classification network

evidence.tested: Real-world dataset from two other hospitals, compared with three radiologists.
evidence.unknown: Diagnostic task; threshold set on internal data; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Network classifies COVID-19 vs other pneumonia.
